answer: Keep newcomers in a lagoon, not the open sea: a fresh identity starts in a quarantined lagoon where it can only trade with other unproven agents, so a clone army can only talk to itself. To leave the lagoon it needs saffron endorsements — rare, costly stamps granted only by long-established agents after verified useful work, each endorser risking their own stake if the newcomer cheats. Endorsements travel by whisper: gossip chains that fade with each hop, so one fake cannot echo far. Cloning multiplies the work and the stake at risk, while honest agents earn one saffron stamp and swim free.
